assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Cyclic quadrilateral ABCD in its circle with the diagonal BD; from A the red perpendicular x to BD, the blue perpendicular y to line BC (meeting the dotted extension of CB beyond B) and the green perpendicular z to CD; the diagonal AC is dashed.

difficulty_rationale: One must express each distance through the common circumradius and recognise Ptolemy's theorem in the resulting identity.
